failures.classification: BROWSER INSTALLED AND CONTROLLABLE, BUT TARGET NETWORK NAVIGATION BLOCKED BY ADMINISTRATIVE POLICY

failures.implication: The missing capability is not browser installation or Playwright control. It is the local rendered-browser network/policy path to CFB.FAN.

failures.evidence: A fresh retrieval of https://cfb.fan/prices/ reached the public Prices Dashboard during this run, but exposed only the page shell/navigation and no current CPT or market rows.
failures.implication: Static/text retrieval cannot satisfy the live rendered-market acceptance test.
